description: BC Roads Map Service - BC Albers *Deprecated* is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Deprecated as of November 2022. This resource has not been updated since 2018 and is only to be used for legacy application support. Please use the updated BC Basemap - vector tile cache. Contact GeoBC for more information. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are BC, Canada, WMS, cache, populated places. It offers 3 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, KMZ, WMS. The portal shows 2026-02-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
